title: Tor modules of an affine blowup algebra are annihilated by a power of the ideal in degrees beyond the number of generators
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement bounds the Tor modules of an affine blowup algebra in degrees beyond the number of generators of the ideal (author lemma at source lines 4554-4560, label lemma-annihilates-affine): there is a c with Tor_i(B, M) annihilated by the c-th power of the ideal for all modules M and all i at least the number of generators. The proof (source lines 4562-4602) uses the presentation of the blowup algebra as a quotient modulo torsion, builds the Koszul complex on the blowup relations, and shows the relevant homology is annihilated by a power of one generator; the final step converts that power into a power of the whole ideal using that the Tor module is a module over the blowup algebra (proof lines 4600-4602). The Koszul bookkeeping and the final conversion are the content. H2.
